newsitem.title: GERMANY: Summary of Ifo August German business survey.
newsitem.headline: Summary of Ifo August German business survey.

text.p: Following is a summary of key points in the IFO economic research institute's monthly business survey for August (sectors are west German unless otherwise stated, comparisons are against pvs month):
Ifo last week said its business climate index showed a rise to 94.4 in August from 94.0 in July.
Production plans - reflect improved competitive position
Production plans - could be strongly increased
Note - Chemicals industry had fewer complaints on current situation, metals saw inventories improve despite halting demand, paper saw a big uptrend in coming months.
Orders level - improved despite weak demand
